lines.text: Job says miners dig silver, gold, iron and copper from the earth, in deep darkness far from where people live.
Sapphires with flecks of gold lie in the rocks below, on a path no falcon has seen and no lion has prowled.
The miner overturns mountains and stops up streams, but Job asks where wisdom can be found, and says it is found in the land of the living.

wrong_details.wrong: it is found in the land of the living
wrong_details.true: it is not found in the land of the living

lines.text: The sea says wisdom is not with it, gold of Ophir cannot buy it, and Abaddon and Death say they have never heard of it.

wrong_details.wrong: Abaddon and Death say they have never heard of it
wrong_details.true: Abaddon and Death say they have heard a rumor about it

lines.text: God understands wisdom's way, sees everything under the heavens, and tells man the fear of the Lord is wisdom.
